paragraphs: "Yudghan" too laid claim to prophethood, and his adherents claim that he is the Messiah, that he did not die, and they await his return. The Yudghanites forbid meat and [wine-]drinking, and make much use of prayer and fasting. They claim that the Sabbaths and the festivals lapse in this age, and are only a "remembrance" (dhikr). Some of the Karaites have already shared with them in this statement — we shall mention it later, together with the answer to them.

: The Yudghanite doctrine that, in the age of exile (before the coming of the Messiah), the Sabbaths and festivals are not actual observances but a "symbolic remembrance" — a deferred semiotic act. Compare contemporary eschatological currents.
